alias.added: “{{skill}}” now counts as “{{profile}}”. Job scores are recalculated in the background.
alias.title: “{{skill}}” is the same as…
alias.description: Pick the skill from your profile that means the same. It's added as a synonym in config/skill_aliases.yaml and your jobs' scores are recalculated.
alias.none: No skill in your profile matches.

row.gone: No job in the period asks for it any more

noProfile.title: You don't have a profile yet
noProfile.body: Gaps are calculated against your profile. Create it with the skill `update-profile`.

title: Skills
intro: What your jobs ask for and your profile doesn't cover. Often it's vocabulary: if it's the same as one of your skills, say so and the score is recalculated. If you have it, add it to your profile; if not, it goes to your training plan.
addHave: Add the ones I have to my profile ({{count}})

covered.title: Your profile covers what your jobs ask for
covered.body: No missing skills across {{jobs}} jobs (open, and approved or sent in the last {{days}} days).

summary: {{count}} missing skills across {{jobs}} jobs: the open ones and those approved or sent in the last {{days}} days. The weight adds 1 per job that requires it and 0.5 per job that lists it as nice-to-have, times the job's score.
